title: Delivery evidence report
description: Actual artifact is a UTF-8 Markdown report, not a JSON object: the decoded Markdown text. A single # title line, then exactly these ## headings once each in order: Objective; Method and scope; Results; Run log; Derived comparisons; What the results show; Requests the evidence cannot support; Limitations. The tables are copied from the evidence bundle by the host. Every number must be an evidence value or a host-computed derived value.
